item.title: Show HN: Clippa - Record your screen. Send a link (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
item.description: I use Loom all the time for quick video notes. But on Loom's free plan, a video can be at most 5 minutes, and you can't download your own recordings. Paid plans start at $180 a year per person. So I built Clippa: a simpler, much cheaper alternative. Clippa records your screen and camera right in your browser and hands back one finished video. No app to install, no editing, no meeting that could have been a 90-second video. - Record and download for free, as much as you like, no account needed. - Share a link to your recording, free to start. - Pro is $20 a year: 60-minute recordings, no Clippa branding, and room for all your videos. Try it here: https://tryclippa.com Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50269031 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
